objectives.note:
0.5 New Farrow's Act 4 quest unlocks the 13 Ancient Runes — powerful weapon-type-specific runes crafted at Remnant encounters. Crafting detail in the Codex.
Heads-up Farrow does nothing further here for now — his quest only completes later at the Plunder's Point Deserted Post .
Runeforging ladder One tier unlocks per act: Act 1 Armour Runeforging → Act 2 Runic Inscriptions → Act 3 Unique Runeforging → Act 4 Ancient Runes . Act 4 has no Runestones — collect the Torn Map Pieces (4 in total) instead.
